# Commit hash map

Before publication the history was rewritten (2026-11-19) so that every commit carries the GitHub noreply author address; this changed every commit hash. The docs were updated to the new hashes; the Lean sources were left byte-identical to the verified snapshot, so a hash quoted in a Lean comment (e.g. `3aa118e` in `Proofs/Arm64/Nat/Callees.lean`) is an old one. Look it up here: old → new, newest first.
